specification.phase_boundary: Complete timer spans prepared solver invocation, canonical JSON UTF-8 encoding, and SHA-256 payload hashing. Rank guards and coarse phase wrappers are installed outside complete-call timing and restored in finally. Phase timers wrap only named top-level training/diagnostic functions; intervals are sequential and non-overlapping.

provenance.count_loading: Validated pinned Git reports only; no card ranking or board enumeration. Independent numeric-rule replay uses the pinned W/T/L rows outside all timed calls.
provenance.identity: The runner records the clean Git revision, runtime, complete relevant tracked source/spec hashes and both pinned source report identities before and after the measured calls.

method.complete_call: Prepared solver invocation, canonical JSON UTF-8 encoding, and SHA-256 payload hashing, inclusive.
method.phase_timing: Top-level training and diagnostic function wrappers only; wrapper and rank-guard installation is outside complete-call timing and restored in finally. Phase intervals are checked as non-nested and non-overlapping; remainder includes other solver work, serialization, and hashing.
method.warm_calls: One unwrapped serialized reference followed by three instrumented complete calls per fixture; all call times, phase observations, UTC boundaries, payload hashes and raw payloads are retained.
method.physical_counts: Pinned validated Git artifacts only. Each reference and instrumented call is guarded against ranking and board enumeration. Independent numeric-rule replay uses pinned rows outside all timed calls.
method.limitations: Two fixed prepared cases, one Python runtime, and coarse instrumented timings; no general speed, native, allocation, or RSS claim.

historical_equity_preparation.scope: Exact unordered five-card boards per compatible private pair; logical counts, not time or memory guarantees.

work_budget.scope: Conservative configuration-derived tree/row forecasts, full requested scalar CFR traversal and exact evaluation/own-hand best responses, plus table/setup/output bookkeeping. Forecasts may reject a configuration whose realized tree would be smaller. Source-inclusive mode also charges historical full-board preparation/bookkeeping (rank instructions are separately capped, excluded from these loop units); prepared-counts charges current table work only. No current ranking. Not bytecode, elapsed time, allocation bytes or RSS bounds; trusted counts require independent provenance. Pair-mean indexing aggregates each private pair's hidden W/T/L categories to a conditional signed mean computed as a Fraction before binary64 conversion; its setup charge is included above. Floating-point summation order may differ.

payload.scope: Approximate equilibrium of a finite heads-up preflop betting abstraction with hidden full-deck final-board W/T/L settlement at every nonfolded closed betting line. All-in and limped lines go directly to forced checkdown; no board cards are revealed, and no postflop decisions, antes, rake or multiway play are modeled.

vector_upper_bound.loop_entry_scope: Conservative modeled vector-backend validation, aggregation, row setup/normalization, training, and diagnostic loop envelope; not bytecode count, runtime, or process RSS. World enumeration and tree construction use separate existing guards.

source_admission.scope: Logical exact ranking work and grouped output rows; not elapsed time, allocated bytes or RSS.

work_budget.scope: Full requested training and exact diagnostics, with at most three categorical rows per pair. Source bookkeeping excludes internal hand-ranking instructions; rank calls are independently bounded before ranking. Logical counts are not bytecode, elapsed time, allocation bytes or RSS bounds.

payload.scope: Finite heads-up fixed-flop betting abstraction with every legal turn/river integrated under forced checkdown. No later-street betting, full-deck preflop, rake or multiway equilibrium. Pot-share values split the existing pot symmetrically and include matched additional wagers.

equity_preparation.validation: Structural consistency only; supplied counts require trusted provenance.
